senses.gloss:
कित् कित् (akin to कि), ii. 3, Par. To perceive, to know (ved.).
 --Frequent. चेकित्, To see, Bhāg. P. 6, 16, 48. Desider. चिकित्स.
 1. To cure, Bhartṛ. 1, 83; to administer remedies, Pañc. 183, 22 (read चिकित्स्यमानो).
 चिकित्सित, n. Physic, Man. 10, 47.
 चिकित्स्य, Curable, MBh. 12, 418.
 --Comp.
 --Caus. of the desider. चिकित्सय, To cure, Mālav. 47, 11.
 --Caus. or i. 10, Par. केतय.
 1. To invite, MBh. 13, 1596; Man. 3, 190.
 2. † To dwell.
 3. † To desire.
 --With the prepos. वि वि, desider. To doubt, MBh. 5, 2701.
 विचिकित्सित, Uncertain, Bhāg. P. 2, 4, 10.
 --Cf. संकेत्.

कितव कितव (akin to कित्), m.
 1. A gamester, Man. 3, 151.
 2. A cheat, Bhāg. P. 8, 20, 3; a rogue, Megh. 110.
 3. pl. The name of a people, MBh. 2, 1832.
 --Comp.
